import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

# Dataset with categorical variables for frequency encoding
data = {
    'category': ['A', 'B', 'A', 'C', 'A', 'B', 'A', 'D', 'B', 'A',
                 'C', 'A', 'B', 'A', 'E', 'A', 'B', 'C', 'A', 'B'],
    'value': np.random.randn(20)
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Calculate frequency count for each category
counts = df['category'].value_counts()

# Calculate relative frequency (proportion) for each category
proportions = df['category'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Map both count and proportion back to the dataframe
df['freq_count'] = df['category'].map(counts)
df['freq_proportion'] = df['category'].map(proportions)

# Compare with label encoding
le = LabelEncoder()
df['label_encoded'] = le.fit_transform(df['category'])

# Print the results showing all encoding methods
print("Category frequencies:")
print(counts)
print("\nCategory proportions:")
print(proportions.round(3))
print("\nAll encoding methods:")
print(df[['category', 'freq_count', 'freq_proportion', 'label_encoded']].drop_duplicates())
